component: Node lease readback continuity and retained ordinary candidates
mechanism: Retain fixed-size expiry bounds and the earliest monotonic sample for each unresolved ordinary None/Open log stamp under the held ETag. A read of the old root does not cancel a native write or erase that history.

Require the same node, lineage, address, protocol and process generation before adopting a historical ordinary candidate. Reject unknown stamps/expiry bounds and retain the exact current-body comparison. Recovery and sealing states do not enter ordinary candidate history.

Require prior authority to remain live at both latest observed wall and monotonic bounds before positive readback adoption or applied completion. Stale event timestamps cannot undo a later observed expiry.

Bound adoption by the original earliest sample, the expiry delta and the observed remaining published time. Clear unresolved history when its ETag is displaced; never extend authority from a callback completion instant.
contracts_preserved: No lease, callback, handler or operation deadline increase; native fixture keeps its original one-second lease and three-second actor operation setting.
No larger work bank, additional production worker, retry identity substitution, new wire format, marker increment, relaxed durability proof or VM/container resource change.
A genuine expiry remains a fence. The older native COMMIT tail that finished after its replica fence is not repaired by recognizing another owner record.

owning_boundary.pure_core: Eleven public cellar-logic integration tests. Eight fail and three controls pass before the change; all eleven pass afterward, within the full 107-test integration suite. Cases include changed ordinary stamps, multiple possible winners, unknown stamps/expiry bounds, ETag displacement, stale samples, matching bodies after clock steps, both prior deadlines and foreign/recovery records.
owning_boundary.native: The real public Node, Fleet log publisher and conditional SQLite object store. Hold one original physical CAS, report a connection reset, read the original root, then let that CAS win before executing the next real CAS with the published Open stamp. Require that next CAS to reject. No business mutation is reissued.
native_after_oracles: The original physical CAS commits, the newer stamped CAS is rejected, and the owner retains authority.
One original HTTP mutation returns value 1; a later GET still returns 1 after crossing a full original TTL.
The original process generation, Open log, nonempty ensemble and may-have-fleet-ack marker remain in the actual stored record.
The original physical task, both nodes and the explicit observer domain are joined; the caller-owned executor remains usable.
owning_boundary.scope: Focused response-loss reconciliation, not a reproduction of Linux storage timing or the entire RPC matrix. The explicit connection error makes loss independent of timeout delivery.
